explanation.fa: It is a privilege to address you با it صوری، موقعیت سخن‌گفتن را ارزیابی می‌کند؛ محتوای ارزیابی در to address you است. I am honored نیز احساس افتخار را برجسته می‌کند، نه برتری شخصی را. delighted، eager و honored در این بافت نقش توصیفی دارند؛ نباید بی‌دلیل برای آن‌ها عامل یا رویداد مجهول اختراع کرد.
explanation.en: It is a privilege to address you uses anticipatory it to evaluate the speaking opportunity, with the content supplied by the infinitive. I am honored foregrounds gratitude rather than personal superiority. example.text: Good morning, distinguished guests, it is a privilege to address you today.

takeaway.en: These patterns elevate the occasion rather than necessarily asserting the speaker’s superiority.

explanation.en: How our organization supports ... complements on and identifies the talk’s focus. How concerns manner, while the clause retains statement order, organization supports. Contrast it with the direct question How does the organization support ...?, which requires auxiliary inversion.

title.en: Separating history, achievement and agenda

explanation.en: Began and reached locate completed events with ten years ago and last year. Supports and serve describe the organization’s current function. Will focus and will continue project the agenda forward. Distinguish these temporal signals from ceremonial politeness when reconstructing the timeline.

explanation.en: In the communities we serve, the object relative marker that or which is omitted. We is the subject of serve and communities is its object. Omission is possible in this object position. The clause means the communities receiving services from us, not communities serving us.

explanation.en: Mobile vaccination campaign compresses several specifications into a noun group: campaign is the head, vaccination gives its type and mobile specifies delivery. Over fifty thousand families sets a lower bound, not an exact figure. Thousand remains uninflected after fifty, while families is plural.

context.en: A formal transfer of the speaking turn, not floor ownership. Interpret this closing turn directly without inventing a narrative to repair the chair’s irregular sequencing.

example.text: The floor is now yours for the full presentation, Doctor.

translation.fa: دکتر، اکنون نوبت شماست که ارائهٔ کاملتان را انجام دهید.
translation.en: The floor is now yours for the full presentation, Doctor.

prompt.fa: بهترین توصیف کارکرد کلی این تبادل چیست؟
prompt.en: Which description best captures the overall function of this exchange?

text.fa: گزارش نهایی برای تصمیم دربارهٔ بودجه
text.en: A final report to decide on funding

text.fa: معرفی رسمی سخنران و زمینه‌سازی برای ارائه
text.en: A formal introduction that frames the speaker’s presentation
A recruitment interview about clinical experience

explanation.fa: رئیس جایگاه keynote speaker را معرفی می‌کند و در پایان نوبت ارائه را واگذار می‌کند؛ این تبادل خودِ ارائهٔ کامل نیست.
explanation.en: The chair identifies the keynote speaker and eventually yields the floor, framing rather than constituting the full presentation.

prompt.fa: حوزهٔ فعالیت سازمان چگونه معرفی می‌شود؟
prompt.en: How is the organization’s purpose presented?

explanation.fa: دکتر کامرانی می‌گوید موضوع سخنرانی چگونگی حمایت سازمان از community health programs است.
explanation.en: Dr. Kamrani states that the talk will focus on how the organization supports community health programs.

prompt.fa: آغاز فعالیت سازمان به چه زمانی برمی‌گردد؟
prompt.en: When did the organization’s work begin?

explanation.fa: We began our work ten years ago نقطهٔ آغاز را مشخص می‌کند.
explanation.en: We began our work ten years ago explicitly locates the starting point.

prompt.fa: فعالیت از چه بستری آغاز شده است؟
prompt.en: What was the initial setting for the work?

text.en: A small clinic in a rural area
A large hospital in the city center
A research center at a university

explanation.fa: دکتر از a small clinic in a rural area نام می‌برد، نه بیمارستان شهری یا دانشگاه.
explanation.en: Dr. Kamrani names a small clinic in a rural area, not a city hospital or university.

prompt.fa: دربارهٔ گسترهٔ کارزار سیار واکسیناسیون چه ادعایی می‌شود؟
prompt.en: What claim is made about the reach of the mobile vaccination campaign?

explanation.fa: reached over fifty thousand families یک حد پایین می‌دهد؛ over اجازه نمی‌دهد عدد را دقیقاً پنجاه هزار بدانیم.
explanation.en: Reached over fifty thousand families sets a lower bound; over rules out interpreting the figure as exactly fifty thousand.

prompt.fa: این نتیجهٔ کارزار مربوط به چه زمانی است؟
prompt.en: When was that campaign result achieved?

explanation.fa: last year در همان جمله، زمان نتیجهٔ گزارش‌شده را تعیین می‌کند.
explanation.en: Last year in the same sentence dates the reported result.

prompt.fa: گوینده چگونه اعتبار دستاورد را توزیع می‌کند؟
prompt.en: How does the speaker distribute credit for the achievement?

text.fa: به تعهد تیم و اعتماد جوامع نسبت می‌دهد.
text.en: By attributing it to the team’s commitment and the communities’ trust.

text.fa: به مدیریت شخصی خودش و منابع مالی نسبت می‌دهد.
text.en: By attributing it to personal leadership and financial resources.

text.fa: به حمایت رئیس نشست و مهمانان نسبت می‌دهد.
text.en: By attributing it to the chair’s and guests’ support.

explanation.fa: credit belongs to ... دو منشأ را نام می‌برد: تیم متعهد و اعتماد جوامع؛ گوینده موفقیت را صرفاً شخصی نمی‌کند.
explanation.en: Credit belongs to ... names the dedicated team and community trust, avoiding an exclusively personal claim to success.
